newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA'S ZINC FIRM APR-JUNE NET AT 380 MLN RUPEES.
newsitem.headline: INDIA'S ZINC FIRM APR-JUNE NET AT 380 MLN RUPEES.

text.p: India's state run Hindustan Zinc Ltd has earned a net profit of 380 million rupees in the first quarter of financial year 1997/98 (April-March), the Mines Ministry said in a statement on Thursday.
The statement said the company acheived a turnover of 2.56 billion rupees between April and June 1997 against a target of 2.31 billion rupees.
The firm exported 29,300 tonnes of zinc concentrates in the first quarter against the target of 50,000 tonnes for the whole of 1997/98, the statement said.
